01About Me

Hi, I'm Marissa. I'm passionate about computer graphics, visual storytelling, and socially-responsible computing.

At Brown, I focus on hands-on projects in rendering and rigid-body simulation. From translating real SIGGRAPH papers into working code to audio-reactive installation computer art pieces, I love working on weird and wonderful projects with other people.

02Projects
/01 · 2026

Skydancer ↗

A visual/performance robotic art piece inspired by Loïe Fuller's dance, built with a team. Used computer-vision motion capture and dynamic drone path programming to choreograph Crazyflie and large quadcopter drones to captured movement.

PythonOpenCVROSRobotics Video
/02 · 2026

Rigid Body Rolling Simulator ↗

Implemented the forward algorithm from the SIGGRAPH paper Putting Rigid Bodies to Rest with a team of three. Used gradient descent to iteratively solve for stable rigid-body configurations without physical simulation, then assigned probabilities to those configurations via a Morse–Smale complex.

C++Paper ImplementationMesh Processing
/03 · 2026

Deformable Solid Simulator ↗

Implemented the Finite Element Method for deforming meshes (O'Brien & Hodgins, 1999) in C++, producing physically based simulations of deformable solids under stress and collision.

C++FEMOpenGL Mesh Processing Paper Implementation
/04 · 2026

Path Tracer ↗

A fully functional Monte Carlo path tracer in C++ — soft shadows, reflection and refraction, importance sampling, depth of field, Russian-roulette path termination, and gamma correction.

C++RenderingSamplingOpenGL
/05 · 2026

As-Rigid-As-Possible Modeling ↗

Built an ARAP mesh-manipulation tool with a custom sparse-matrix solver and Cholesky (L-matrix) decomposition, plus an additional cubic stylization deformation for faceted, cube-like mesh styling.

C++Linear AlgebraMesh Processing Paper Implementation
/06 · 2026 · Installation

elevator ↗

A real-time graphics art installation with audio-reactive software, built by a team of four. I individually implemented the rigid-body physics system (rotation, translation, inertia tensors), screen-space bloom, and depth-buffer-based real-time fog — and owned version control and the code-integration pipeline.

C++OpenGLPython
/07 · 2024

Rookie to Cookie ↗

A web app that algorithmically generates recipes via API calls and lets users save them. Built with a team of four; I implemented the front-end design, calendar page, login authentication, and profile page, and connected the front-end to the back-end.
